lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.title: Причина сбоя синхронизации доходит до безопасного сообщения
value.meaning: A positively known server-only failed cohort explains a WebGIS request failure, possible maintenance/overload and retry later. Other, mixed or untrusted failures do not claim maintenance. Current missing network wins even when a server presentation was created earlier.
value.value_origin: Known final PULL/PUSH IO, typed lookup Parse and readonly SYNC_NONE resource/schema/count HTTP failures (including the approved optional-count fallback boundary) -> exact account SyncResult/thread -> four primitive version/flags/IO/Parse fields plus one LOCAL framework Parcelable owner reference in a fresh account Bundle -> final account/child/cleanup fences in ProjectSyncRunner -> safe resource-only FailurePresentation -> fresh String-only MESSAGE_ALERT Intent/notification builder. MainActivity receives the existing package-scoped alert while resumed; this broadcast is not durable UI delivery.
value.units: Human-readable localized text; no coordinates, CRS, server-body units or technical status dump.
updates: Existing operation lifecycle decides when a dialog/notification/progress message is delivered. A displayed explanation is separate from remote ACK, durable save or full-project completion.
actions: Read the cause and suggested next action; retry through the existing operation only after the reported condition changes.
conditions: Both main Lisa/Belka source paths; foreground manual alert and error notification retain their existing lifecycle/permission gates.

Owner output is ephemeral in-process pass state. It is never forwarded into the UI Intent, preferences, remote request or persistent journal. Parcel copy with original local result falls back generic.
Late unclassified IO/Parse, auth/conflict/skipped/db/busy errors and child/import/cleanup/cancel state add OTHER; final cancellation does not become server failure.
A late noncancel child failure of an otherwise clean project gets one explicit IO/name outcome after cleanup, using per-target failure state rather than display-name/global-result identity.
External-database body text can classify only HTTP422;408 remains generic/connect-timeout, while429/all5xx remain server. Same HTTP retry classification is preserved.
value.saved_state: No new persistent error journal, automatic resend, saved-state migration or server mutation is introduced. Existing local edits/recovery and cancellation ownership remain separate contracts.
expectations: Same counters in a different SyncResult cannot borrow SERVER; next scope/end/unknown schema/malformed primitive types are generic.
Known lookup Parse alone can preserve SERVER without adding IO; mixed local Parse or later IO/Parse cannot remain pureSERVER.
Actual resource-backed notification and manual Intent show shared Russian/English server wording; raw HTTP/password/URL String API remains suppressed.
Create SERVER while connected, disconnect before consuming notification or manual alert: show no-internet copy and the manual failed-project list.
Previously clean late child failure adds1IO exactly once; prior account/cleanup error, normal cancellation and equal display names retain their independent meanings.
unknowns: Technical89 source/model methods passed, including actual safe notification/Intent and late-outcome helper cases. Actual queue/drain timing, Android permission/channel delivery, foreground receiver lifecycle, large-font windows and device locale/resource merge remain NOT_RUN.
TUS status loss, arbitrary HTTP200 error envelopes, remote-commit ambiguity and partial successful uploads are not reclassified or rolled back by this message bridge.
